clusters.label: Muted positive integration
clusters.summary: The independence narrative holds. Power users grumble but mostly stay; coverage is neutral-to-positive. The majority of futures land here.

clusters.label: Consumer backlash
clusters.summary: Skeptical coverage catches fire on Twitter; productivity power users turn hostile and a morale leak compounds it. Sharp, vocal, churn-threatening.

clusters.label: Competitor wins
clusters.summary: Linear moves fast on a switcher campaign during the uncertainty window and captures a meaningful slice of wavering users.

pivotal.description: Across these futures, the single biggest determinant of which cluster you land in is whether the acquisition messaging leads with 'independent' or 'integrated'.
